stories.title: Garrett Mitchell Injury Update — Best-Case News, Frelick Returns
stories.angle: Following the scary HBP in the Little League Classic on Aug 24, the Brewers got the best possible outcome: X-rays on Garrett Mitchell's right forearm were negative. Official diagnosis is a right forearm contusion. No IL placement announced. Compounding good news: Sal Frelick (right shoulder strain rehab) is expected to return during the Aug 25-27 series vs. the Mets, giving Milwaukee outfield depth exactly when they need it most.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Good news out of Milwaukee: Garrett Mitchell's X-rays after the Little League Classic HBP came back negative. Right forearm contusion. No IL placement. Brewers get some breathing room — and Sal Frelick is expected to return vs. the Mets this week. #Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Sal Frelick is returning from his shoulder rehab right when the Brewers need outfield depth most. Mitchell's forearm is a contusion, not a fracture. 81-49 Milwaukee doesn't miss a beat heading into the Mets series. #Brewers #MLB

article.headline: Brewers Get Best-Case News on Mitchell — Forearm Contusion, No IL, Frelick Returns

stories.title: PCA NL MVP Race — Cubs 76-56, 30 Games Left
stories.angle: The Cubs climbed to 76-56 (up from 74-56 two days ago), confirming they've been winning. PCA's cold streak (.111 over last 8 games at peak) was the narrative — but the season case remains the strongest in the NL: 7.7 fWAR (NL lead), .281 BA, 30 HR, 78 RBI, 31 SB, 22 OAA. Ohtani is at .928 OPS. The award discussion is live with 30 games left. Does PCA break out of the slump?

stories.title: Misiorowski — Sub-1.75 ERA, Historical Season in Progress
stories.angle: Jacob Misiorowski's most recent start came Aug 21 — 6 shutout innings, 6 K, 13-5 record improved. Updated season line: 13-5, 1.68 ERA, 216 Ks, 0.76 WHIP in 24 starts. For context: finishing a full season below 1.75 ERA would be among the most dominant single-season ERA performances in modern baseball. His next start comes around Aug 26-27. With 6-7 starts remaining, this ERA figure is within reach of the history books. Also: Frelick returning provides depth behind Misiorowski in case he needs protection on strong-run days.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: After Aug 21: Misiorowski is 13-5, 1.68 ERA, 216 Ks, 0.76 WHIP. He hasn't started since. Next outing is ~Aug 26-27. Finishing a full season with a sub-1.75 ERA in the modern era is a historically rare thing. He's right there. #Brewers #CyYoung

article.headline: Misiorowski's 1.68 ERA Is the Kind of Number That Gets Written Into Baseball History

stories.title: NL Wild Card Race — Cubs Protect No. 1, Schwarber's HR Surge
stories.angle: The NL Wild Card picture as of Aug 25: Cubs 76-56 (No. 1, 30 games left), Phillies 73-59 (No. 2, ~30 games left), Padres 71-61 (No. 3). Kyle Schwarber hit a home run on Aug 24 in a Phillies comeback win over the Cardinals, extending his ML HR lead. The Cubs' incentive to hold No. 1 remains: avoid Misiorowski and the Brewers (best record in baseball, 81-49) in Round 1 of the playoffs. The Padres-D-backs race for the No. 3 seed is the live battle.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: NL Wild Card: Cubs 76-56 (No. 1). Phillies 73-59 (No. 2). Padres 71-61 (No. 3). Meanwhile, Kyle Schwarber hit another HR last night. He's the ML home run leader. The Cubs still want nothing to do with the Brewers in Round 1. #MLB #NLWildCard
